label: input n late in the original phase (diffuse late-original-phase unit)
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, never at t<2, never on the delimiter or during copy. Rate rises with position (orig_idx 7-8 about 9x lift) and with L, peaking on the last 1-3 original tokens. Input token n carries about half the activation mass (11.5x lift) and the top activations (~0.9-1.0 of max) are almost all n at a late position; h, l, o, f, v, r fire weakly. Earlier tokens v, y, c, t in the prefix raise the rate somewhat (n plus seen v/y/c/t gives precision 0.58 but recall 0.26). Many late n inputs stay silent, and the other half of the mass is spread across many tokens at late positions, so the n predicate tops out near F1 0.35 (mass recall 0.50). Broader late-position predicates reach about 0.85 mass recall but precision is only about 0.04.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: n, h, l, o, f, r; least: b, 0, t, p) and the third original token (most: y, v, c, q, a, u; least: e, f, b, z); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, L=9 & t=8, t=7.
